pass-readers.label: com.we.conveyor-pass-daemon.ci-red-recovery-watch-we
pass-readers.note: The label is the ci-red-recovery-watch-we pass daemon launchd job. No explicit clone: prototype-load resolves the clone from that installed plist WorkingDirectory, so overlays register on the clone the watcher actually runs from (the shipped template installs wev-review-daemon; the live install runs wev-pass-readers), and self-sync adopts the new code.

drain.label: com.plateau.drain-daemon
drain.note: The plist's DRAIN_DAEMON_WE_CLONE is the DATA clone lane-1, which carries no overlays. Register overlays on the CODE clone code; see scripts/settings/operator-task.json edgeClones.drain and scripts/lib/daemon-clone-registry.mjs.

findings: excluded-file drop made loud (config-excluded selected test files are named and not run, previously skipped silently)
focusRefs entry for lane/verify-forge-route added to scripts/settings/pr-limit.json
rebuild.mjs accepts inherited ignore-owner env for any readyOnly caller (feature-scope, PR 6222 body)
acquireWrite accepts explicit ignoreOwners that can bypass a listed foreign live reader (feature-scope)
preparation still writes refs/objects before the ref guard; read-only does not cover all clone bytes (feature-scope)
lock exclusion weakens the previous reader-exclusion guarantee (inherent to the feature)

scripts/operations/dispatch-lane.mjs:429 — Glob refusal applies only within multi-path entries; separate glob entries remain accepted despite the pre-existing overlap-check limitation. Probe: `we:src/a*b.mjs` and `we:src/ab*.mjs` both cover `we:src/abb.mjs`, but `scopesOverlap` returns false, allowing conflicting work through lease/rival exclusion.

scripts/readiness/forge-slot-markers.mjs:283 — Adds `idle` to the release allowlist, allowing deletion of markers for listed runs with `code:null` that previously remained blocked. Two zero-count samples replace per-run completion evidence. The underlying count comes from a non-atomic directory listing (scripts/readiness/forge-exec-run.mjs:647), so this loosens the fail-closed guard without proving that run’s cleanup.
The last-known-good fallback can proceed for up to the 2-min window after a freeze is newly published while reads keep timing out (PR #6289, accepted option A).
merge-gate still enforces the freeze per merge.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:197 — Replaces the all-green requirement with an exception that discards FAILURE, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, ACTION_REQUIRED and STARTUP_FAILURE when a later same-name check succeeds in another run. Previously these outcomes blocked update-branch.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:153 — Matching workflow_id, display name and timestamps does not prove job replacement across runs; independent same-name jobs can mask failures. The lookup validates only workflow_id, without binding the check to its claimed run/job or verifying equivalent execution context.

scripts/lib/drain-queue-safety.mjs:59 — One or two `merge_conflict` removals now bypass commit-binding validation and the same-head failure hold whenever the live PR is CLEAN. CLEAN does not prove the failed merge-group conditions changed; previously these cases required operator inspection.

scripts/__tests__/merge-ai-prs-prestage.test.mjs:188 — Replacing `merge_conflict` with `ci_failure` removes integration coverage that prevented a force-push from bypassing an unbound conflict failure. The test now passes despite that protection being removed.

The canonical Codex audit on head be8f9f2629 reports WEAKENED. The findings are exactly this ruled change: restarts are exempt from the shared per-head ceiling, and the tests that pinned "restarts spend / are blocked by the shared budget" were replaced by R452 tests (a second non-restart action on the same head is still refused, in current-pass, would-do and intent evidence). The sweep stays shadow-only.

scripts/settings/review.json:3 — Shipped timing changes from fast-check success to `push`, permitting review while both prerequisites are queued. Confirmed by a direct probe: pending checks now allow review, whereas the previous default refuses. `scripts/lib/review-timing.mjs:195` grants this permission even with `startEarly: "shadow"` or `"off"`; the added publication guard does not preserve the review-start gate.

scripts/merge-ai-prs.mjs:2686 — Pre-existing fail-open dependency handling remains: full sweeps clear absent `blockedBy` dependencies even when listing failures make `contextComplete=false`; an unreadable repo's open blocker can therefore be bypassed.

scripts/merge-ai-prs.mjs:5616 — Pre-existing `--assume-complete-context` overrides the incomplete-context guard after listing failures, allowing an unobserved carrier to count as landed despite the new inventory checks.

scripts/conveyor/reconcile-pass.mjs:456 — The snapshot-disabled fallback returns direct() without author validation, but PR_LIST_JSON_FIELDS omits author. This pre-existing bypass still accepts authorless rows despite the claimed fail-closed guarantee.

scripts/conveyor/reconcile-pass.mjs:471 — Fresh planner reads now rely on a paged reader that requests only `labels(first:100)` without checking label completeness (`scripts/lib/pr-list-paged.mjs:75`). Omitted `review-status:draft-withdrawn` or `red-team:blocked/pending` labels bypass promotion guards (`scripts/conveyor/reconcile-core.mjs:2769–2776`). A synthetic probe confirmed an incomplete label connection is accepted as complete; the added tests do not cover this fail-open path.

note — pre-existing limit shared with the snapshot path: the `labels(first:100)` page query is the same one the shared PR snapshot and the drain listing already use; a PR with more than 100 labels is not a realistic state, and this branch does not change that query.

scripts/lib/drain-red-team-evidence.mjs:76 — Retains the pre-existing reliance on mtime to select finished reviews; start times only protect unfinished reviews. An older acceptance updated after a newer rejection wins. A read-only probe confirmed recovery schedules a fresh pass using that stale acceptance, ignoring the newer rejection.

scripts/lib/drain-poison-guard.mjs:130 — The new API path relies on a pre-existing raw-text grep that misses YAML-escaped identities. Main’s `bornAs: "xabc12\u0033"` and an added card’s `bornAs: xabc123` decode identically, but a read-only probe returned `{ok:true}`, allowing the duplicate through admission.

scripts/lib/policy-cascade.mjs:79 — Per-leaf merging retains the repository’s weaker build gates when an operator supplies only `build.priority` or `build: {}`. A read-only probe confirmed the effective policy changes from `full`/`always` to `related`/`selected`, reducing verification from the full unit suite plus standards to diff-selected checks (scripts/verify-lane.mjs:366).
